name: Tuning-Free Model-Size Control
definition: A controller that makes model size an input to training by using multiplicative dual ascent on a log-domain error with an asymmetric release, a setpoint held above the budget, a deletion floor, and a single terminal projection onto the budget.
summary: Tuning-Free Model-Size Control enforces an exact primitive count in 3D Gaussian Splatting via a closed-loop controller and terminal projection, ensuring consistent model size across scenes unlike variable-size alternatives.
